Denominator = the 47 2'MOE ASO-treated subjects whose BASELINE platelet count was already below the LLN. Numerator = 3 subjects who reached the <75-50 K/uL band. The source does NOT state a percentage for this subgroup, so readout_value is the subject COUNT and readout_unit is n_subjects; no percentage has been computed. rows.source_table: Results, section 'No increase in clinically relevant platelet decreases with longer-term mipomersen treatment' (sentence: 'Assessment of all RCTs found that the confirmed platelet counts below 100 K/uL did not occur until after at least a month of dosing')
rows.notes: Grade rationale: platelet nadir 75-99 K/uL -> schema grade 2 (moderate, 50-99 x10^9/L band) | TIME-TO-ONSET observation, qualitative. No confirmed platelet count below 100 K/uL occurred before at least one month of dosing in any randomized placebo-controlled trial. No numeric incidence is attached to this statement in the source, so readout_value is TBD. Supporting detail from the Results 1st paragraph: of the 7 ASO-treated subjects who reached <100 K/uL, 2 were from an open-label extension with 1.0 and 4.4 years of exposure, 3 from phase 2 trials with 6-26 weeks of exposure, and 2 discontinued after 37 weeks (210 mg/week, phase 3) and 9 weeks (400 mg/week, phase 2). | Dose expressed as mg/week; dose_or_conc_value carries the dose BAND exactly as printed where the source reports a band rather than a single dose.;verified_against_source
